doc: GENERATED by blender/kit/detail/evolved_catalog.py (edit that, then run it). Keys: evo1_<petId>[_low], evo2_<petId>[_low] (body + Tail / Halo / Aura / EyeLid groups), evowing_<petId>_<1|2|2b>_<L|R>[_low] (1 = stage 1 Wing pair, 2 = stage 2 Wing pair, 2b = stage 2 Wing2 pair; pivot = the body's WingL/R or Wing2L/R attachment). Aura meshes are the body's Aura (orbit) and Halo (bob) groups (kit/detail/evolved.py). k is absolute (1.25 / 1.125, Low 0.65 / 0.55). Sets (body + wings) keep the recipe 4.2 triangle budgets (evo1 15k / Low 4.5k, evo2 20k / Low 6k). MeshPart counts follow the 4.3 name contract (one part per group, key and shade; wings are separate L / R keys), so the set part caps are 60 / 40 (evo1) and 84 / 56 (evo2) instead of 50 / 16 and 60 / 18 (the same deviation as the kit's base-pet Low sets).
